key.name: gap-size
key.description: Margin in pixels around maximized windows on edges without a panel.

key.name: skip-panel-edges
key.description: Do not add a gap on edges that already have a reserved panel/work-area inset (Dash to Panel, top bar, etc.).

key.name: peek-blur
key.description: Experimental: blur the desktop wallpaper in the margin around maximized windows. Uses a separate wallpaper clone and does not modify Blur My Shell.

key.name: peek-blur-radius
key.description: Gaussian blur radius for the peek margin. Larger values are cheaper thanks to downscaling.
